items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: It was Lester, Bumps, Lady Day, my wife Dorothy, and I think Louis was there

ctx.x: dance, boy. The only person that could dance like her was when Dorothy was dancing. Dorothy could dance that way. Dorothy could be a hell of a dancer. But Marie Bryant would throw these guys into a loop.
She's in that Jammin' the Blues, that film...
